text: When thou blamest a man as faithless or ungrateful, turn to thyself. For the fault is manifestly thy own, whether thou didst trust that a man who had such a disposition would keep his promise, or when conferring thy kindness thou didst not confer it absolutely.
author: Marcus Aurelius
location: On campaign on the Danube frontier, e.g. Carnuntum or Sirmium (presumed)
